build_escnmd_backbone: build an eSCNMDBackbone model with configurable sphere channels, lmax, and quaternion Wigner support
create_escnmd_forward_pass: create a forward pass through eSCNMDBackbone to compute equivariant node embeddings from atomic data
build_mlp_efs_head: build an MLP_EFS_Head to predict energy, forces, and stress via autograd derivatives from node embeddings
create_mlp_stress_head: create an MLP_Stress_Head to predict isotropic and anisotropic stress tensor components from node embeddings
refactor_balance_channels_batched: refactor the balance_channels_batched function to balance contiguous embedding channels to a target sum per system
